scope: Record the post-transaction ERC-1967 implementation slot and Upgraded(address) events returned by Rayls Testnet RPC. This investigation does not yet identify the implementation active at the 2026-11-21 transaction block.

rpc_methodology.transport_note: A previous urllib.request call received HTTP 403 on eth_blockNumber. The same JSON-RPC method succeeded using curl; the subsequent scan used curl.

historical_transaction_block.result: RPC error: state at block #24825929 is pruned
historical_transaction_block.interpretation: No historical implementation address was obtained from this request.

established: The proxy's current ERC-1967 implementation slot points to 0x937471b6acdad0c77d6874d0546d6009e09cd3f0.
The RPC returned two Upgraded(address) events for this proxy after the historical transaction block in the scanned interval.
At block 25699353 the event recorded new implementation 0x9644667cc096964bafb6a533d57873544fbfb956.
At block 25714062 the event recorded new implementation 0x937471b6acdad0c77d6874d0546d6009e09cd3f0.
The current implementation was set again by an observed event on 2026-11-27.
not_established: Which implementation was active at block 24825928.
Whether 0x937471b6acdad0c77d6874d0546d6009e09cd3f0 was already active before the 2026-11-21 transaction.
Whether the 2026-11-26 upgrade replaced 0x937471... or another implementation; the pre-upgrade address has not yet been established.
Whether the two returned events are the complete lifetime upgrade history of the proxy; the scan began at the historical transaction block, not at proxy deployment.
interpretation.important_alternative: The current implementation 0x937471... may have been active before the historical transaction, then replaced by 0x964466... on 2026-11-26 and restored on 2026-11-27. The observed post-transaction events alone cannot distinguish this from a first-time installation of 0x937471... on 2026-11-27.
interpretation.previous_audit_context: An earlier audit artifact recorded implementation address 0xad9667049f14d1757d147f652c41dc241c57091c as the then-associated implementation, but its exact observation block/time and direct storage-slot evidence must be independently reconciled before treating it as historical proof.

next_checks: Retrieve the proxy address metadata from the Explorer API to identify its creation transaction and creation block.
Scan Upgraded(address) logs from proxy creation through block 24825928, using chunked eth_getLogs queries.
Inspect the two upgrade transactions and their receipts, including emitters and implementation contract creation/verification metadata.
Reconcile the earlier audit's 0xad9667049f14d1757d147f652c41dc241c57091c reference with a dated source or slot observation.

change_control.note: This is a separate dated evidence record. It intentionally does not assign a historical implementation to the 2026-11-21 transaction.
